Jab yeh aayat utri, phir unhon ne naap tol bahut durust kar liya. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Hilal bin Talq ne ek martaba Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se kaha ke Makka Madine wale bahut hi umda naap tol rakhte hain. Aap (R.A) ne farmaya woh kyun na rakhte jab ke Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai aayat (Wailul-lil-mutaffifeen) (Surah Al-Mutaffifeen: 1) hai. Pas tatfeef se murad naap tol ki kami hai, khwah is surat mein ke auron se lete waqt zyada le liya aur dete waqt kam diya. Isi liye unhein dhamkaya ke yeh nuqsan uthane wale hain ke jab apna haq lein to pura lein balkeh zyada le lein aur dusron ko dene baithein to kam dein. Theek yeh hai ke 'kalu' aur 'wazanu' ko muta'addi maanein aur 'hum' ko mahalla mansoob kahein, go baaz ne ise zameer-e-muakkad maana hai, jo 'kalu' aur 'wazanu' ki posheeda zameer ki takeed ke liye hai aur maf'ool mehzoof maana hai jis par dalalat-e-kalam majood hai, dono tarah matlab qareeb qareeb ek hi hai. Quran-e-Kareem ne naap tol durust karne ka hukum is aayat mein bhi diya hai. Aayat (Wa auful-kaila iza kiltum wazinu bil-qistasil-mustaqeem, zalika khairun wa ahsanu ta'weela) (Surah Al-Isra: 35) yani jab naapo to naap pura karo aur wazan seedhe tarazu se tol diya karo. Aur jagah hukum hai. Aayat (Wa auful-kaila wal-meezana bil-qist, la nukallifu nafsan illa wus'aha) (Surah Al-An'am: 152) naap tol insaaf ke sath barabar diya karo, hum kisi ko us ki taqat se zyada takleef nahin dete. Aur jagah farmaya aayat (Wa aqeemul-wazna bil-qisti wa la tukhsirul-meezan) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 9) yani tol ko qaim rakho aur meezan ko ghatao nahin. Hazrat Shuaib (A.S) ki qoum ko isi bad-aadat ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala ne gharat-o-barbad kar diya. Yahan bhi Allah Ta'ala dara raha hai ke logon ke haq maarne wale kya Qayamat ke din se nahin darte? Jis din yeh us Zaat-e-Paak ke samne khade ho jayenge, jis par na koi posheeda baat posheeda hai na zahir. Woh din bhi nihayat holnak-o-khatarnak hoga. Badi ghabrahat aur pareshani wala din hoga, us din yeh nuqsan-rasan log Jahannam ki bhadakti hui aag mein dakhil honge, woh jagah bhi nihayat tang-o-tareek hogi aur maidan-e-aafaat-o-baliyaat se pur hoga aur woh masaib nazil ho rahe honge ke dil pareshan honge, hawas bigde hue honge, hosh jata rahega. Sahih hadith mein hai ke aadhe aadhe kaanon tak paseena pahunch gaya hoga.

(Muwatta Malik) Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai us din Rahman Azza-wa-Jal ki azmat ke samne sab khade kapkapa rahe honge aur hadith mein hai ke Qayamat ke din bandon se suraj is qadar qareeb ho jayega ke ek ya do neze ke barabar uncha hoga aur sakht tez hoga. Har shakhs apne apne aamal ke mutabiq apne paseene mein gharq hoga, baaz ki eriyon tak paseena hoga, baaz ke ghutnon tak, baaz ki kamar tak, baaz ko toh unka paseena lagam bana hua hoga aur hadith mein hai dhoop is qadar tez hogi ke khopdi bhuna uthegi aur is tarah us mein josh uthne lagega jis tarah handiya mein ubal aata hai aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne munh par apni ungliyan rakh kar bataya ke is tarah paseene ki lagam chadhee hui hogi phir aap ne hath se ishara kar ke bataya ke baaz bilkul doobe hue honge aur hadith mein hai sattar saal tak baghair bole chale khade rahenge, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke teen sau saal tak khade rahenge aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke chalees hazar saal tak khade rahenge aur das hazar saal mein faisla kiya jayega. Sahih Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se marfoo'an marwi hai ke us din mein jis ki miqdar pachaas hazar saal ki hogi. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Basheer Ghaffari (R.A) se farmaya tu kya karega jis din log Allah Rabbul Aalameen ke samne teen sau saal tak khade rahenge, na toh koi khabar aasman se aayegi na koi hukm kiya jayega. Hazrat Basheer kehne lage Allah hi madadgar hai, aap ne farmaya suno jab bistar par jao toh Allah Ta'ala se Qayamat ke din ki takleefon aur hisab ki burai se panah mang liya karo. Sunan Abu Dawood mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Qayamat ke din ke khade hone ki jagah ki tangi se panah manga karte the. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood se riwayat hai ke chalees saal tak log uncha sar kiye khade rahenge, koi bolega nahin, nek-o-bad sab paseene ki lagam mein chadhe hue honge. Ibn-e-Umar farmate hain sau saal tak khade rahenge (Ibn-e-Jareer). Abu Dawood, Nasai, Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab raat ko uth kar Tahajjud ki namaz shuru karte toh das martaba Allahu Akbar kehte, das martaba Alhamdulillah kehte, das martaba SubhanAllah kehte, das martaba Astaghfirullah kehte. Phir kehte dua (Allahummaghfirli wahdini warzuqni wa'afini) Aye Allah mujhe bakhash, mujhe hidayat de, mujhe roziyan de aur aafiyat inayat farma, phir Allah Ta'ala se Qayamat ke din ke maqam ki tangi se panah mangte.

Toh farmaya un ka anjam Sijjeen hona hamari kitab mein pehle se hi likha ja chuka hai. In jhutlane walon ki us din kharabi hogi, unhein Jahannam ka qaid khana aur ruswai wale almnak azab honge. 'Wail' ki mukammal tafseer is se pehle guzar chuki hai, khulasa-e-matlab yeh hai ke un ki halaki, barbadi aur kharabi hai, jaise kaha jata hai 'Wail-ul-fulan'. Musnad aur Sunan ki hadith mein hai: "Wail hai us shakhs ke liye jo koi jhooti baat keh kar logon ko hansana chahe aur use wail hai, use wail hai."
